skill.name: customization
skill.description: Configure middleware extension hooks for affolterNET.Web.Bff. Use when adding custom middleware, extending the pipeline, or integrating third-party components.

generated_query: I'm working on a multi-tenant BFF using affolterNET.Web.Bff. I need to add custom middleware that extracts a tenant ID from the `X-Tenant-Id` request header and stores it in `HttpContext.Items` early in the pipeline. Additionally, I want to add audit logging middleware that logs the authenticated user, request path, and HTTP method for every request before the endpoints are executed. Can you show me how to configure these two custom middleware components in the BFF pipeline, including where they should be placed relative to the built-in middleware? The tenant middleware should run after routing but before CORS and authentication; the audit middleware should run after authentication but before the endpoints. I also need to see example implementations of both middleware classes.

edit_instructions.replacement_text: | `ConfigureAfterRoutingCustomMiddleware` | After CORS | Tenant resolution, request context |
